notes.title: July update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it's Nico again for the monthly update!👋


Status update


Last month, I shared that the game was content-complete and outlined what remained to be done before launch.

I'm thrilled to say that just a month later, we're officially moving into beta builds!

Balancing is complete, most bugs have been squashed, and the game is ready for console builds. Translations are coming along nicely, with several languages already 100% finished.


Gamescom Reminder


I'll be at Gamescom next month, from August 20 to 25, at the Indie Arena Booth. If you're attending, come say hi! We'll have some goodies waiting for you.

That's it for today, let me close this update with some new footage of L'Ankou, with a special pixel art animation made by the great Soda Piggy!


[previewyoutube="z7SpJzCOjrM;full"][/previewyoutube]
See you soon for another update,

Take care!



Nico & Pineapple Works

notes.title: June update: Game complete and what's next!🔥
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Nico here for an exciting update!


I'm super happy to announce that the game is finally complete!🎉


Although there's still work to be done (more on that in a minute), this feels like such a big achievement, after more than 3 years of work!!


[previewyoutube="xKFNue0b1f8;full"][/previewyoutube]
I couldn't have reached this milestone without all the support I've received from everyone, so from the bottom of my hear, thank you!


That means the game launches next week, right...?


Soon, but not yet! There's still a lot of work to be done. Our translation community is hard at work localizing the game, and I'm currently working on balancing the 3 difficulty modes and making all achievements.



After that, we'll do a final round of QA on the entire game, and I'll fix the last bugs that haven't been found yet.


Meet me at Gamescom


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/3f80492fcf6b97f5b7c61a3fb7134661b32c8ceb.png"]



I'm also super excited to announce that I'll be at Gamescom from August 20 to August 24! I'll be showcasing Dreamed Away in the Indie Arena Booth the entire week, so make sure to come and say hi if you're there as well!

You can see the full Indie Arena line-up at Gamescom here: 

https://indiearenabooth.de/gamescom2025/games



That's it for today! As always, feel free to join our Discord! We post updates regularly and discuss new features with the community, so come join us!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/b05128aa6d10e582443927001a9885b5aa788780.png"]

Join our Discord!



PS: Now that the game is complete, we'll have a launch date soon, so stay tuned!



See you very soon with another update,

Nico & Pineapple Works

notes.title: 2024 round-up
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

What a year 2024 has been for Dreamed Away! 

Kickstarter campaign

So much progress has been made on the game this year.

It started amazingly well with the Kickstarter campaign in February, I still have goosebumps just thinking about it, and I can't thank all backers enough for making it a success. This is what made it possible for me to work on the game full-time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/a00619c21913032e3e180db293a243f94e71a68e.png

Chapter 4 completed!

The fourth chapter was completed a few months later, following by QA sessions together with Pineapple Works, and then our fifth playtest in June! Several builds were tested and discussed over 3 weeks. Feedback on chapter 4 was great, and the community has been incredibly helpful, as always. 

Major demo updates and iterations on other chapters

Since then, we've released 2 major demo updates, with improved dungeon design, better tilesets, and new cutscenes. Chapters 2 to 4 also received several updates, ranging from balancing improvements to new scenes and side-quests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/73507c6517da638ab84dbfa517faf21a402a3908.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/516c2afc0e8b23d1d32e12617533ae665879d306.png

The road ahead

As you know, Dreamed Away is scheduled to be released in 2025.
I'm currently working full throttle on chapter 5 and I expect to announce the next playtest early next year.

Until chapter 5 is done and we're ready for the next playtest, here are some screenshots from new locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/f9b4800342838e6fda10e8f399ee58d44ec44928.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/193a34b7bc2f6c33760538df400f7c6a684d32a3.png

I will also send surveys to Kickstarter backers early next year to start fulfilling in-game rewards, like portraits, custom NPCs, items, etc.

Merry Christmas everyone, and see you next year!

One last thing, if you have played the demo, please consider leaving a review, it helps a ton!
https://partner.steamgames.com/apps/landing/2342600


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/223640c6d5738997f4f743abe036b5b5ac29a297.png

Merry Christmas and see you next year!
Nico & Pineapple Works

notes.title: Demo update 2.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/1beae5b2ffc34bb12c78ece8a96e9b3082d00725.png

We’re excited to announce yet another demo update!

New features

The biggest changes introduced in this release are the new difficulty modes.

Difficulty modes have been built as an accessibility setting, and as such they can be set when starting a new game or at any point (except in combat) from the options pause menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/00d9256363284d3dc2fdc4cf41b96c9309fdddfa.png

The game currently has 3 difficulty modes:

- Dream: Your damage output is increased, enemies attack slower and their most challenging attack patterns are disabled.  We recommend this option to players who want to enjoy the story with a more relaxed experience.

- Reality: Difficulty settings as Dreamed Away was designed and intended. We recommend this option for your first time playing the game. Expect some challenge!

- Nightmare: Enemy attacks are faster and more dangerous. For players who thought 'Reality' wasn't a challenge. Expect to struggle as enemies will hold nothing back.

Other new features & improvements

But that's not all! We brought in some of the latest changes from the full game in this build:

- Newly-found equipment pieces will be equipped automatically, if Theo has none on him
- New mix of the tracks Walking In The Rain and Home Sweet Home
- New portrait assets for Théo
- New game icons on all platforms
- New skip button added to the credits, allowing for going back to main menu quickly
- Pressing Cancel/B during dialogues now fast forwards, without confirming any potential choice

Bug fixes

This update also comes with the following bug fixes:
- Fix a collision bug with a plant in the living room
- Fix a soft lock when selling all items at a shop
- Minor localization fixes

And finally, we updated the credits with the names of all the new playtesters who helped balance the new difficulty modes. A huge thank you to everyone for testing & sending feedback!

As always, we're open to feedback! Feel free to tell us about your experience!

Also... we would love to have you in our Discord! We post updates regularly and discuss new features with the community, so come join us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/b05128aa6d10e582443927001a9885b5aa788780.png

Nico & Pineapple Works

notes.title: Major demo update!
notes.content:
We’re super excited to announce the biggest demo update of Dreamed Away to date!

With more than 1400 commits in 2023, the v2 demo release brings all changes and improvements we've made to the game in the last year.

Features

 Collectible drawings
Players can now collect Louise's drawings and browse them from the main menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/c524127c21732b6be12cce0c17bee7106135000b.png

 Redesigned interior sprites
All interiors in the game have been completely redrawn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/13b540f390c54ff33a315aa64410dbdda6d6ca09.pngLouise's bedroom before and after

 Equipped items with 3 equipment slots

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/2d0964023b9c32e22f4d403333aa9055a56ed8cf.pngNew equipment slots from the main menu

 New combat mechanics
A lot of changes have been made to the combat system, from balancing to smaller tweaks and bug fixes.
When equipped, some items will modify combat mechanics or stats in various ways.
Also, now when attacking from behind, enemies now get the initiative!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/165765c2bb116b8a59d9f840bd41d9804a38352a.pngA ghost attacked by surprise!

 Better controller support
Players can choose between different button styles and layouts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/5be64fe68230361340f462da83b13fbe18f78ab7.png

 Keyboard input remapping
Players can now freely remap keyboard controls.

 Footstep sound effects
A much requested feature!

 Redesigned menus
We have made several improvements to the look and feel of the menu system.


Localization
Thanks to our community of translators, we're happy to announce the support of three new languages:

 Simplified Chinese
 Spanish (Spain)
 Italian
The Japanese localization is almost ready, we'll publish another demo update very soon!
Reach out to us on our Discord server if you would like to help us iron out the Japanese translation.


We really hope you'll enjoy all the changes in this new version of our demo. We're always open to feedback so feel free to tell us about your experience!

Also... we would love to have you in our Discord! We post updates regularly and discuss new features with the community, so come join us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42617139/8b07760de55ad82e31b7596217e72455468aff06.png

Nicolas Petton & Pineapple Works
